data.content: Replaced SSH/sudo/egress grant transport with land-queue Persona bearer through Sneka Auth and existing Diffinite service bearer; preserved parent-admin ceiling, atomic audit, locking, and bounded grant/read/revoke. Removed host mutation. Focused endpoint, transaction, ops-dispatch, boundary, and static tests pass; full local lint passed through late bobbin fixture, whose macOS sed portability fix passes 14/14.
